verse.verse_1: Nay! I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
verse.verse_2: And nay! I swear by An-Nafs Al-Lawwamah.
verse.verse_3: Does man think that We shall not assemble his bones
verse.verse_4: Yes, We are able to put together in perfect order the tips of his fingers.
verse.verse_5: Nay! Man desires to break out ahead of himself.
verse.verse_6: He asks: "When will be this Day of Resurrection"
verse.verse_8: And the moon will be eclipsed.
verse.verse_9: And the sun and moon will be joined together.
verse.verse_10: On that Day man will say: "Where (is the refuge) to flee"
verse.verse_12: Unto your Lord will be the place of rest that Day.
verse.verse_13: On that Day man will be informed of what he sent forward, and what he left behind.
verse.verse_14: Nay! Man will be well informed about himself,
verse.verse_15: Though he may put forth his excuses.
verse.verse_16: Move not your tongue concerning to make haste therewith.
verse.verse_17: It is for Us to collect it and that it be recited.
verse.verse_18: And when We have recited it to you, then follow its recitation.
verse.verse_19: Then it is for Us to make it clear.
verse.verse_20: But no! Rather you love the present life of this world,
verse.verse_22: Some faces that Day shall be Nadirah.
verse.verse_24: And some faces that Day will be Basirah,
verse.verse_25: Thinking that some calamity is about to fall on them.
verse.verse_26: Nay, when it rea- ches to the collarbones.
verse.verse_27: And it will be said: "Who can cure him"
verse.verse_28: And he will think that it was the parting;
verse.verse_29: And one shank will be joined with another shank.
verse.verse_30: The drive will be on that Day to your Lord!
verse.verse_31: So, he neither believed nor prayed!
verse.verse_32: But on the contrary, he denied and turned away!
verse.verse_33: Then he walked in conceit to his family admiring himself!
verse.verse_34: Woe to you! And then woe to you!
verse.verse_35: Again, woe to you! And then woe to you!
verse.verse_36: Does man think that he will be left neglected
verse.verse_37: Was he not a Nutfah of semen emitted
verse.verse_38: Then he became an `Alaqah; then shaped and fashioned in due proportion.
verse.verse_39: And made of him two sexes, male and female.
verse.verse_40: Is it not so then, that He would be able to give life to the dead
